temporal_state_chain.observed: Cheryl looks stressed and overwhelmed by the stacks of paperwork and planning for the new community outreach project. Cheryl accepts Maria's offer of help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria suspects Cheryl may be stressed by the project work, but has not yet confirmed how overwhelmed she is.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Maria confirms that Cheryl is overwhelmed and would welcome assistance.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Cheryl needs support with the outreach project, and Maria can help her.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: concern and compassion, with willingness to assist
temporal_state_chain.intention: to offer and provide help with Cheryl's paperwork and planning

temporal_state_chain.observed: After helping Cheryl, Maria observes Cheryl handling responsibilities better and growing in confidence. At the staff meeting, Maria suggests Cheryl lead the next phase, the team leader is receptive, and Cheryl accepts gratefully.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria believes Cheryl has improved and is gaining confidence, but she does not yet know whether Cheryl is ready or willing to take on leadership.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Cheryl is ready to take on the challenge, appreciates Maria's confidence, and the team supports the suggestion.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Cheryl is a capable and willing candidate for the leadership role.
temporal_state_chain.intention: to support Cheryl in taking on the leadership role and help the project succeed

temporal_state_chain.observed: Maria worries that Cheryl might perceive her leadership suggestion as overstepping. Maria privately reassures Cheryl that she wanted her to feel supported, not pressured. Cheryl says she was surprised but appreciates Maria's support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria believes Cheryl accepted the leadership suggestion, but she is uncertain whether Cheryl felt pressured or resented Maria's intervention.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Cheryl was surprised by the suggestion, but she is not upset and values Maria's belief in her.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: There is no hard feeling or misunderstanding; Cheryl feels supported by Maria.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: initial worry and anxiety, then relief and reassurance
temporal_state_chain.intention: to reassure Cheryl and preserve their positive relationship

temporal_state_chain.observed: Maria feels relieved that Cheryl valued her honesty and support. Maria proposes co-leading the project together. Cheryl enthusiastically agrees and says Maria's guidance has been invaluable.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria believes Cheryl appreciated her support and that their relationship is positive; she wants a closer collaborative arrangement.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Cheryl welcomes co-leading and sees them as a great team.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Co-leading with Cheryl will be mutually supportive and effective.
temporal_state_chain.intention: to co-lead the project with Cheryl and support each other

temporal_state_chain.observed: Maria and Cheryl have successfully collaborated on several projects, strengthening their partnership. Cheryl is enthusiastic about teaming up for more projects in the future.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria believes their collaboration has been fruitful and their partnership is strong.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Cheryl also wants to team up for more projects and is excited about what they can achieve together.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Their partnership is strong and has promising future potential.
temporal_state_chain.intention: to continue teaming up with Cheryl on future projects
